notes: Migrated from Brazil claim matrix Markdown with Phase-1 fidelity repairs: Mercosul/RMCCI removed from current cites; BR-FX-04 downgraded; departure claim aligned to mandatory proof framing.

claims.subject: FX market regulatory authority
allowed_wording: regulated by the Banco Central do Brasil

claims.subject: Freely agreed FX transaction rates
claims.rule: The exchange rate for FX transactions is freely agreed between authorised institutions and their clients

claims.subject: Floating exchange-rate regime
claims.rule: Brazil operates a floating exchange-rate regime
claims.matching_source_note: BCB Política cambial page (current). Legacy Mercosul page is superseded and must not be cited.

claims.subject: FX operations without statutory value limit
claims.rule: Under Law 14.286/2021, FX-market operations may be conducted freely without a statutory value limit, subject to applicable legislation, CMN guidelines, and BCB regulation
claims.matching_source_note: Lei 14.286/2021 Art. 2 and Art. 5; executed through authorised institutions under Res. 277
allowed_wording: subject to applicable legislation, CMN guidelines, and BCB regulation

claims.subject: cash declaration threshold
claims.rule: Amounts above USD 10,000 or the equivalent in another currency must be declared through the e-DBV on entry and exit; requirement applies to paper money in cash
claims.matching_source_note: Lei 14.286/2021 Art. 14 §1-I; §3 + Receita Federal entry/exit guidance

claims.subject: No explicit quantitative carrying maximum on entry
claims.rule: The reviewed rules establish a declaration threshold rather than an explicit maximum carrying amount for travellers on entry
claims.matching_source_note: Art. 14 establishes declaration obligation; no explicit upper carrying limit stated
allowed_wording: declaration threshold rather than an explicit maximum

claims.subject: Departure cash declaration and supporting evidence
claims.rule: Cash above USD 10,000 or equivalent must be declared through the e-DBV on departure; the traveller must present the declared cash and the applicable supporting evidence identified by Receita Federal
claims.matching_source_note: Receita Federal departure guidance: declared cash plus applicable proof (purchase / prior entry declaration / qualifying receipt or withdrawal)

claims.subject: Old resident FX-account limits/approval wording
claims.rule: Residents are subject to BCB limits and approval requirements for foreign currency accounts
claims.matching_source_note: Old on-file wording overstates the rule; not carried forward.
forbidden_inferences: BCB approval required for all resident FX accounts

claims.subject: No general resident entitlement to domestic FX accounts
claims.rule: General resident access to domestic foreign-currency accounts is not established by the sources reviewed
claims.matching_source_note: Resolução BCB 277 Art. 69–70 list eligible holder categories; no general resident entitlement
allowed_wording: do not establish unrestricted general access
not established by the sources reviewed
forbidden_inferences: all residents may hold FX accounts freely
residents may freely open foreign-currency accounts

claims.subject: FX accounts under eligible categories
claims.rule: Domestic foreign-currency accounts are available only under BCB-defined conditions and eligible account-holder categories
forbidden_inferences: all residents may hold FX accounts freely
available to all residents without restriction

claims.subject: Non-resident FX account eligibility is category-bound
claims.rule: Foreign-currency accounts are governed through defined eligible categories and operating conditions; no broad general statement that non-residents may operate such accounts more freely is supported
forbidden_inferences: non-residents may operate such accounts more freely

claims.subject: Authorised-institution channel for FX market operations
claims.rule: FX market transactions must be conducted through institutions authorised by BCB
allowed_wording: must be conducted through institutions authorised by BCB

claims.subject: Certain capital-account controls
claims.rule: Brazil maintains controls on certain capital account transactions
claims.matching_source_note: Not verified as stated within source budget.
forbidden_inferences: Brazil maintains controls on certain capital account transactions

claims.subject: Current-account liberalisation classification
claims.rule: Current account transactions are largely liberalised
claims.matching_source_note: Lei 14.286 Art. 2 supports free FX-market operations without statutory value limit subject to law/regulation, but does not alone prove the broad classification 'current-account transactions are largely liberalised'. Downgraded for drafting exclusion.

claims.subject: No general resident outbound FX limits claim
claims.rule: Sources do not establish a general BCB limits claim for residents taking foreign currency out as previously worded
claims.authority: Banco Central do Brasil / Receita Federal
claims.matching_source_note: Narrow traveller declaration/proof rule only; do not carry broad resident-limits wording
forbidden_inferences: residents are subject to BCB limits on taking foreign currency out

claims.subject: Capital repatriation / BCB approval bundle
claims.rule: Capital repatriation and certain payments require BCB approval or documentation
claims.matching_source_note: Compound proposition not verified as stated.
forbidden_inferences: capital repatriation and certain payments require BCB approval

claims.subject: FX conversion through authorised institutions
claims.rule: Foreign-exchange conversion is available through institutions authorised by BCB to operate in the FX market
claims.matching_source_note: Lei 14.286 Art. 3 + Res. 277 Art. 29 + BCB authorised-institutions list

new_claim_candidates.proposition: Individuals may buy/sell foreign currency cash up to USD 500 between themselves without using an authorised institution
new_claim_candidates.note: Lei 14.286/2021 Art. 19 — not admitted to draft until controlled matrix revision

new_claim_candidates.proposition: Penalty for undeclared cash above USD 10,000: forfeiture of the excess to the National Treasury + criminal sanctions
Exporters may retain foreign-currency export proceeds abroad without repatriation obligation

review_hypotheses.hypothesis: Lei 14.286/2021 materially liberalised the FX regime relative to older circulars
Receita Federal declaration implementing rules may have been updated relative to IN RFB 1.385/2013
COAF AML reporting scope is distinct from customs declaration and BCB FX framework
